body:
All PRs merged into main ΓÇö running full test suite to validate integration health and document results.

## Results
- **101 test files** | **2,283 tests** | **96.1% pass rate** (2,189 passed / 89 failed / 5 skipped)
- **Duration:** 45.1s

## Reports added to `REPORTS/`
- `TEST_RUN_REPORT_2026_02_20.md` ΓÇö full analysis, failure breakdown, recommendations
- `TEST_RUN_SUMMARY.txt` ΓÇö executive one-pager
- `FAILING_TESTS_CHECKLIST.md` ΓÇö 89 failures triaged by P1/P2/P3
- `TEST_RUN_RAW_OUTPUT_2026_02_20.txt` ΓÇö raw vitest output

## Critical failures (P1 ΓÇö block production)
- **Invalid foreign key references** in DB schema (`src/__tests__/api-database-validation.test.ts`)
- **Migration files out of order** (`tests/database-schema.test.ts`)

## Medium priority (P2)
- Admin API ΓÇö 32 failures
- Emergent system ΓÇö 35 failures (likely WIP)
- RBAC `getUserProjects` ΓÇö Supabase `.in()` mock not working

## Core passing
Auth, chat, memory, journal, UI components all green. Staging conditional on P1 schema fixes; production not yet ready.
